titles: Shift Garlic & Herb Beef Sunday-Style Roast
method: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Peel the potatoes and weigh the listed raw portion before cutting into even 3cm chunks. Parboil in water for 8–10 minutes, drain and shake gently to roughen the edges. Toss with half the measured olive oil and roast on a non-stick tray for 35–40 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and tender. Time the other components to finish alongside the potatoes.

Cut the carrots into slim batons, toss them with one quarter of the measured olive oil and roast on the potato tray for the final 20–25 minutes, turning once, until tender. Keep them separate from uncooked meat or fish.

Use the final quarter of the measured olive oil on the separate protein tray. Shape the 5% beef mince into two compact, flattened portions about 2cm thick; this uses mince, not a roasting joint. Bake on a separate lined tray for approximately 18–22 minutes, turning halfway, until steaming hot through the centre. Check 75°C for 30 seconds with a clean thermometer.
Cut the broccoli into small florets and boil for 4–6 minutes until tender with a little bite. Drain well.
Stir together the measured light mayonnaise, garlic powder, dried parsley in a small bowl and keep this dressing chilled until serving.
Serve the cooked 5% beef mince, roast potatoes, carrots and broccoli together. Spoon the chilled light mayonnaise, garlic powder, dried parsley dressing alongside after cooking.
